title: Gemini caching gets a README mention
summary:
A little garden maintenance: July 5 news reached the README, and Tomdacat AI got one accurate catalog listing.

The README’s Latest News now includes the July 5 entry about Gemini prompt caching with `cache_control` markers.

The README added July 5 entries for Sprout, the WebGL studio /motion, and the multi-model LLM Playground. Older entries made way for them.

The app catalog now has a single, updated Tomdacat AI listing describing its tools for Roblox creators. The duplicate was removed from the App Greenhouse.
